# Vayl - The Premium Study Operating System for JEE Mains, JEE Advanced, BITSAT and UGEE

Vayl is an innovative, AI-driven educational platform created for high-stakes competitive exams in India. This includes JEE (Mains & Advanced), IIIT Hyderabad UGEE, and BITSAT. It serves as a "Study Operating System" that streamlines the cognitive workload of students.

## Core Mission
To replace passive learning with effective active recall and proven spaced repetition. This approach helps students master the extensive JEE syllabus with focused attention.

## Key Capabilities
- **Spaced Repetition System (SRS):** Utilizes a unique scheduling method to tackle the "forgetting curve." This ensures students review concepts at the right time for lasting retention.
- **Active Recall Interface:** Provides a distraction-free study space that helps students reach "Flow State" and enhance information retention.
- **Cross-Platform Ecosystem:** Offers smooth synchronization between the Web platform (Next.js) and Mobile apps (Android/iOS via Expo).
- **Exam-Specific Focus:** Offers in-depth optimization for the IIIT Hyderabad UGEE (REAP/SUPR) and JEE Advanced patterns.

## Target Audience
- **Primary:** JEE Mains & Advanced 2026/2027/2028/2029 Aspirants looking for a premium and organized study flow.
- **Secondary:** IIIT-H UGEE applicants and BITSAT students.
- **The Problem Solved:** Addresses "Information Overload" and "Memory Decay" that often comes with two years of competitive exam preparation.

## Technical Stack & Infrastructure
- **Frontend:** Next.js (TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion).
- **Backend:** Express.js hosted on Railway.
- **Database:** MongoDB Atlas (NoSQL).
- **Deployment:** vayl.in domain with Global CDN for low-latency access in India.

## Educational Philosophy: "The Silent Architect"
Vayl operates as a "Silent Architect." It handles the details of the student's schedule, resource tracking, and memory management in the background. This lets students concentrate entirely on solving problems.
